source_imagegen.prompt: Full-body Ppanamong monkey ringpet click reaction pose: eats exactly one banana while the kangaroo-like pouch keeps several bananas visible; forehead cyan diamond headpiece; tail-tip diamond ring part; no head-side ring; green chroma-key background.
source_imagegen.background_removal: imagegen chroma-key source + remove_chroma_key.py auto-key border soft matte despill edge-contract 1

postprocess.tool: Imagegen single-pose cutout + Pillow deterministic Live2D-style pingpong assembly
postprocess.operation: Rebuilt the click Live2D sheet from a clean generated banana-chomp pose instead of patching the previous AutoSprite frames. The pose is anchored to a fixed body size and animated with subtle chew bob, cheek pulse, crumb flecks, and tail gem sparkle so the pouch bananas remain visible from the first frame through the pingpong return.

pouch_banana_persistence.operation: Persistence is authored in the source pose itself: one banana is held and eaten while multiple pouch bananas remain visible in every generated frame.

runtime_sheet.frame_interval: intended one-shot pingpong; 49 authored frames + deterministic reverse 48..0
